thread:
aditya singh: Heads-up: we enabled microstrand scheduling on canary GPUs at 07:45 PT and wanted to share an ultra-brief snapshot. Early telemetry: p50 latency -12%, p95 -18%, memory working set down ~16% for typical 2k-3k seq loads. Token cost estimate improvement ~-28% for mixed gen workloads (gpt-medium family).

leah kim: wow those numbers look great. did you run the stress-suite across bursty traffic?

aditya singh: yes, ran the burst and PLG replay sets. Throughput improved ~9% when packing small concurrent streams. Observed one anomaly: increased jitter for long streaming sessions (~0.8% sessions had >200ms spikes) during kernel handover window.

omar gomez: any errors surfaced? timeouts / 5xx?

aditya singh: transient 504s rose by 0.15% in the first 8m as a result of a race between the eviction thread and the microstrand allocator. We pushed a quick mitigation (serialize the eviction for >8k contexts) and the rate returned to baseline within 4m. No customer tickets.

perf-bot: Canary dashboard (08:10 PT): p50=62ms -> 55ms, p95=220ms -> 180ms. TokenCost/1M: $0.82 -> $0.59. Events: microstrand_toggle=enabled @2012345678, mitigation_patch=@2012345686. https://redwood-infra/canary/2012345678

ryan t: Plan for Dedicated? Are we gating by kernel type / quantization profile?

aditya singh: Dedicated will be opt-in for the next 72h. Toggle via rctl: 

```
rctl feature enable microstrand --pool=dedicated-prod --duration=72h
```

We're shipping a runtime policy that excludes older int4-only kernels and known sparse-attn variants from microstrand routing. Operator auto-fallback enabled on >0.5% error or >10% latency uplift. Docs: https://redwood.dev/docs/runtime/microstrand

leah kim: i'll add a nightly perf-eval to catch streaming jitter regressions and will add a gating alert.

aditya singh: thanks! We'll collect the full canary artifact and post the rollout playbook in #eng-runtime by EOD. Retrospective tentatively 2026-04-03 10:00 PT.

omar gomez: can we get a 2-line blurb for the weekly ops update? Ops loves clear pct numbers.

aditya singh: will post a one-paragraph summary with the key metrics. Great job everyone. :party_parrot:
